title: ID0427392-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 3130651170773] SPD_FA1_or_Fuse_FC1_AC-Income is true
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
After a reboot,  "SPD_FA1_or_Fuse_FC1_AC-Income is true" flag has turned to true. We set an immediate intervention for charger. After SPD and fuses check, we concluded that all of the cylindrical fuses were gone.
Root cause:
Solution:
Charger is revived after the fuses' replacement.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status: Active
